widget.name: Roster Calendar
widget.description: A customizable roster calendar that displays users or drivers as rows and dates as columns. Supports daily availability and status management for efficient workforce scheduling.

property.caption: Default View
property.description: Initial calendar view (week or month)

property.caption: Show Weekends
property.description: Display Saturday and Sunday in the calendar

property.caption: Users Per Page
property.description: Number of users to display per page

property.caption: Users
property.description: List of users/drivers to display as rows

property.caption: User Name
property.description: Attribute to display as user name

property.caption: Pattern Entity Name
property.description: Full entity name (e.g., Roster.RosterPattern)

property.caption: Pattern User XPath Pattern
property.description: Full XPath association pattern to user (e.g., Roster.RosterPattern_DriverInfo/Tenancy.DriverInfo[Tenancy.DriverInfo_TenantUser)

property.caption: Pattern to User Association Path
property.description: Association path to traverse for user ID (e.g., RosterPattern_DriverInfo/DriverInfo_TenantUser). Use / for multi-hop.

property.caption: Pattern Start Date Attribute
property.description: Attribute name for start date (e.g., StartDate)

property.caption: Pattern End Date Attribute
property.description: Attribute name for end date (e.g., EndDate)

property.caption: Pattern Day Entity Name
property.description: Full entity name (e.g., MyModule.PatternDay)

property.caption: PatternDay to Pattern Association
property.description: Association path from PatternDay to RosterPattern (e.g., PatternDay_RosterPattern)

property.caption: Day of Week Attribute
property.description: Attribute name for day of week (e.g., DayOfWeek)

property.caption: Available Attribute
property.description: Attribute name for availability status (e.g., Available)

property.caption: Roster Day Entity Name
property.description: Full entity name (e.g., Roster.RosterDay)

property.caption: RosterDay User XPath Pattern
property.description: Full XPath association pattern to user (e.g., Roster.RosterDay_DriverInfo/Tenancy.DriverInfo[Tenancy.DriverInfo_TenantUser)

property.caption: RosterDay to User Association Path
property.description: Association path to traverse for user ID (e.g., RosterDay_DriverInfo/DriverInfo_TenantUser). Use / for multi-hop.

property.caption: Date Attribute
property.description: Attribute name for date (e.g., Date)

property.caption: Hours Attribute
property.description: Attribute name for hours worked (e.g., Hours)

property.caption: Type Attribute
property.description: Attribute name for day type (e.g., DayType)

property.caption: On Cell Click
property.description: Action triggered when a calendar cell is clicked

property.caption: Height Type
property.description: How to set the calendar height

property.caption: Fixed Height
property.description: Fixed height value (e.g., 600px, 80vh) - only used when Height Type is Fixed
